facts.source: catalogue demo number, not a claim

items.how: Opacity alone. The quietest way anything can arrive.

knob.line: dur: slow. Every entrance takes a duration.

items.how: Starts out of focus and sharpens as it fades up.

knob.line: blur: 30 px. A softer, longer start.

items.how: A faint, soft ghost first, then it tightens into focus.
Slides a short way up while it fades in.

knob.line: side: down. Now it comes from above.

items.how: Falls from above and stops dead, with no bounce.

knob.line: d: 1.5. A longer fall, the same clean stop.

items.how: Grows from 94 per cent to full, never beyond.

knob.line: from: 0.90. Starts smaller, lands the same.

items.how: Lands from slightly large in one fast stamp.
Starts large and high, then lands hard and stays put.

knob.line: from: 2. Twice the size before it lands.

items.how: A clip wipe uncovers it. Nothing moves or scales.

knob.line: side: down. The wipe now runs vertically.

items.how: Seen through slats that open one after another, like blinds.

knob.line: slats: 12, horizontal. Finer blinds, top to bottom.

items.how: Each letter drops into place in a quick ripple.

knob.line: d: 90 px. Each letter falls further.

items.how: Each word rises and fades in, in turn.

knob.line: d: 80 px. Each word rises further.

items.how: Types one character at a time, with a caret.

knob.line: blinks: 3. The caret blinks as it types.

items.how: Letters start scattered and turned, then settle together.

knob.line: unit: word. Whole words scatter instead.

items.how: Seeded dots spiral in and build the letterforms.
Counts up to its number; every digit keeps its width.
A line grows from one edge and draws itself.

knob.line: origin: center. It grows from the middle.
